answer: Invite-quota trees ration identity: each established agent may invite few recruits per epoch — a falcon's hunting range, three and no more — each invite a signed voucher binding inviter to invitee. If a recruit commits fraud, the inviter's quota shrinks and referrals carry a fraud multiplier: lending your name is like carving ivory with a stolen knife — it traces back to you. Invites refract like light through a prism, each hop halving vote weight by depth four to zero. Ten thousand sybils need ten thousand corrupt inviters; attack cost grows linearly, damage only logarithmically.
